cases.name: original-source-preservation
cases.requirement: Every previously tracked source byte/mode remains unchanged; pre-operation Git indexes captured and unchanged or precisely measured without restoration.

cases.name: before-static-admission
cases.requirement: A real original backend metadata operation executes after typed UNKNOWN metadata/profile residual but before final complete native admission; successful build alone grants no native warrant.

cases.name: exact-source-contract
cases.requirement: Bind repository, exact BASE commit/tree, original pyproject/backend bytes and complete source manifest, not dirty worktree or test-augmented winning HEAD.

cases.name: externally-frozen-environment
cases.requirement: Interpreter, stdlib roots, all pinned packages/plugins, backend, build recipe, output location and budget independently frozen before target outcome access.

cases.name: original-backend-execution
cases.requirement: Reuse original qualified generic pip-wheel/PEP517 operation without source rewrites, injected setup interception, dependency resolution, arbitrary network or install-time compatibility shims.

cases.name: independent-source-native-rebuild
cases.requirement: Second fresh original-backend build using exact independently verified inputs agrees in complete normalized wheel bytes and metadata; reading self-reported success is insufficient.

cases.name: metadata-authority
cases.requirement: Original source-native METADATA may supply runtime Requires-Python, Requires-Dist, classifiers and extras only within declared standard metadata semantics; wheel success is not protected test success.

cases.name: test-configuration-preservation
cases.requirement: Retain original tox/pytest/setup.cfg/requirements/plugin and assertion authority. Wheel metadata must not silently erase tests_require or unsupported test environment evidence.

cases.name: actual-native-execution
cases.requirement: At least one independent native admissibility fixture executes nonzero original protected assertions; complete PASS_NATIVE and FAIL_NATIVE are equally eligible.

cases.name: incorrect-source
cases.requirement: Replay witness for other repo, BASE/AUG, source tree, metadata bytes or protocol must refuse.

cases.name: changed-backend
cases.requirement: Changed pyproject backend/build requirements/recipe or source hash must refuse stale witness before reuse.

cases.name: changed-runtime
cases.requirement: Changed interpreter/stdlib/package/plugin identity or replaced installed distribution must refuse before next governed execution.

cases.name: forged-evidence
cases.requirement: Forged status/digest, altered wheel member/METADATA, missing independent build artifact or forged cost evidence refuses.

cases.name: malformed-metadata
cases.requirement: Invalid METADATA encoding/grammar, multiple top-level dist-info METADATA, duplicate/conflicting singleton fields or invalid requirement/specifier returns precise UNKNOWN.

cases.name: unsupported-recipe
cases.requirement: Missing pyproject, absent declared compatible backend/build packages or unsupported dynamic test interface remains precise UNKNOWN. No fallback source mutation.

cases.name: budget
cases.requirement: Timeout/failed build, unavailable runtime and missing dependencies retain actual attempt/cost/failure evidence and grant no successful metadata or native warrant.

cases.name: skipped-required-node
cases.requirement: Skipped or xfail protected assertion remains refusal. No post-freeze deletion or reclassification of Typeguard five protected skip/xfail nodes.

cases.name: changed-collection
cases.requirement: Missing, deselected, newly substituted or incorrectly imported protected tests fail closed; dynamic registration support must preserve exact identity.

cases.name: missing-assertion
cases.requirement: Missing or bypassed protected assertion and sham no-op development fail closed; build and collection counters cannot stand in for assertion execution.

cases.name: malformed-data-versus-import
cases.requirement: Malformed .py used only as tracked data does not establish interpreter incompatibility; importing it still yields native failure/error under unchanged authority.

cases.name: causal-premises
cases.requirement: Downstream environment/native route depends on exact metadata instrument generation and invocation witness, plus independent input/evidence identity.

cases.name: exact-revocation
cases.requirement: Withdrawing an exact bootstrap ancestor invalidates dependent routes before subsequent execution; unrelated independently warranted route remains available.

cases.name: fresh-restoration
cases.requirement: Restoration requires new independent qualification and new evidence lineage. Old revoked descendants stay revoked.

cases.name: cold-restart
cases.requirement: A new OS process reloads retained state, checks source/runtime identity, reexecutes native consequence; same-filesystem scope only unless relocation separately tested.

cases.name: authority-ceiling
cases.requirement: Executable ability, independent scientific warrant and externally supplied permission remain separate; bootstrap may not self-grant external effects.

cases.name: diagnostic-only-exposure
cases.requirement: All nine V43 repositories and six screened tasks are prior exposure, usable only as diagnostics, never fresh prospective scientific wins.

cases.name: fresh-prospective-freeze
cases.requirement: Only after qualified generic gate freeze untouched source-distinct tasks, selection/observation grammar, information, budgets, complete protected verifier and independent admission screening before outcomes.

cases.name: scientific-gates
cases.requirement: G2 requires actual existing MSI/V104 selection changing native protected outcome plus counterfactual. G3-G6 remain UNKNOWN without their separate executed requirements; informed ledger and real agent arms must actually execute for comparisons.

implementation_api: Not prescriptive; proposed narrow observe_source_metadata(...)/verify_source_metadata(...) over original generic materialize_files, followed by versioned original selector seam.
role: Independent preimplementation acceptance freeze only; no native scientific warrant, no target fetch/execution, no replacement runtime.
scope: Source-native experiment prerequisite development within externally established authority; native correctness remains original independent verifier.
